items.title: Frank Murray Interview, 1960-05-12
items.q: I'm the man that went and got Louis... to get working that band... Get your chance to play with him again until Paul Whiteman sent me for him in 1925.

ctx.x: Chiff was a Kornack player, Stonewall was a guitar player?

Yeah, his brother Stonewall was a guitar player. And Chiff was a trumpet player. And his first band came here. And then on, you know, different fellas, was a trumpet player. Well, uh... Really, the facts. You know, it's different things have come out, different papers have got their view on it. Now, uh, it's never, it's really if the truth is told, and it wouldn't do me, uh, some people tell things they hear, but I'm telling you what I know. Now, with Ori's band, when Louis became with Ori's band, I'm the man…
